verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a sandbox or test environment isolated from production data. The free developer account and developer token (box-docs-31, box-docs-17) let users make API calls, but nothing describes them as an isolated sandbox. A sandbox is a fair ask for a SaaS content platform, so the axis applies and lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
